reason: Machine lens: only the immediate of LDY changes (A0 04 -> A0 02, both 2 bytes, 2 cycles), so nothing moves; listing has wait_high at &A5A0, BNE at &A5A1 branching back to &A5A0, same page, no +1. Old loop 4 DEY (8) + 3 taken BNE (9) + 1 untaken (2) = 19; new 2 DEY (4) + 1 taken (3) + 1 untaken (2) = 9: 10 cycles saved per sfx_write, exit state identical (Y=0, Z=1, N=0; A, X, C, V untouched; sfx_silence's 'Y = 0' note still holds). No self-modified operand or data read in sfx_write (no stores to wait_high/sfx_write+n in src). wait_low (WE-low hold) unchanged. Shortest gap from WE rise to the next STA sysvia_ora_nh with the new loop: tone low->high byte path LDY#2+loop+RTS (17) + LDA abs,X 4 + 4 LSR 8 + EOR 2 + ORA abs,X 4 + BRA 3 = 38 cycles (19us); sfx_silence's next channel ~50; both well over the chip's 8us (32 clocks at 4 MHz), and the SN76489 completes a write while WE is low, so the post-rise wait is margin only. No raster-timed code depends on sfx_write's length.
